description: This file defines an interface and implementation for encoding and serializing attribute sets in the OpenTelemetry Go SDK, including mechanisms for caching and escaping special characters.

classes.name: Encoder
classes.description: Interface for serializing attribute sets into string representations with caching support.

classes.name: EncoderID
classes.description: Struct used to uniquely identify different encoder implementations for caching purposes.

classes.name: defaultAttrEncoder
classes.description: Default implementation of the Encoder interface, uses sync.Pool for buffer reuse and encodes attributes as comma-separated key=value pairs with escaping.

methods.name: NewEncoderID
methods.description: Generates a new unique EncoderID, typically called once per encoder type.

methods.name: DefaultEncoder
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the default attribute encoder with caching and escaping logic.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Serializes an attribute set into a string, escaping special characters and separating key-value pairs.

methods.name: ID
methods.description: Returns the EncoderID of the encoder instance.

methods.name: copyAndEscape
methods.description: Escapes '=', ',', and '\' characters in attribute keys and values to ensure encoding uniqueness.

methods.name: Valid
methods.description: Checks if an EncoderID is valid (non-zero).
